Name: Rebekah's Tiny Island Hut
Author: RebekahArt
Description:
Hi! 

I'm Rebekah, I just started doing mods for SV and I liked how they turned out so much that I wanted to share them.

This is my second mod, I made a replacement for the interior of the island hut since the vanilla one was too big for me, and I added a space for a bathroom.

All the tilesets use in this and all my mods are my own, I made them myself, so please do not redistribute them or this mod.


Some known issues that I have with the mods are:
[list]
[*]When entering the character spawns two blocks ahead of the door instead of in the exact entry.
[*]The fridge doesn't come with the house, you'd have to a add a minifridge. 
[/list]
I don't know how to code so the mod it's probably not perfect, if you have any tips I'd be more than thankful, since I want to do more mods but I'm finding some issues that I don't know how to solve.


The mods used in the pictures are:
- Brick walls from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture [/url]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Atlasphere?gameId=1303]Atlasphere
[/url]- White walls and wooden floor from ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19950]Too Many Swatches II[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/orangeblossom7?gameId=1303]orangeblossom7[/url]
- Kitchen and bathroom floor from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16029]Nano's Retro Style Furniture[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/NanoIsNotRobot?gameId=1303]NanoIsNotRobot
[/url]- Bedroom floor﻿ from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857]Rustic Country Walls and Floors[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DustBeauty?gameId=1303]DustBeauty[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]Rattan Furniture[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url] 


Check my Farm Cave mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39768]here[/url]!

I'll be posting news and content on my site, so if you are interested you can check it out [url=https://rebekahart.weebly.com/]here[/url].

If you would like to donate, it would be more than welcome and I would deeply appreciate it, you can do so [url=https://ko-fi.com/rebekahart]here[/url].

Hope you like my mod, and thank you for downloading it.



Love, R.
